info.text:
"No interest if paid in full" is not the same as 0% APR.
Deferred interest builds from the purchase date and gets charged on the full original amount if any balance is left when the promo ends.
Our simplified math: $1,200 at 29.99% APR, $100 left after 12 months = about $195 in back interest (real issuers use average daily balance, so exact amounts vary). A true 0% intro card: $0 so far.
Store cards averaged 31.3% APR in 2024 vs. 25.2% on general-purpose cards (CFPB).
Sources: CFPB Consumer Credit Card Market report (Dec 2025), CFPB consumer guides.
News and education, not financial advice.
